page.notes: The circular woodcut in the lower right margin is an ornament, not text. The Greek word φυλλεῖον and the place name Groinse / Groense are uncertain from the scan and marked [?]. The running head is printed as "DequeVrbe Groninga." with the words run together; I have given it spaced. The first paragraph starts with the fragment "tati", kept as printed. The marginal note "Antiquitates incertæ." is broken across lines in the print and is given here as one note.
